full_name: Sam Klug | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2018–2019 Edna Newman Shapiro, Class of 1936, and Robert Newman Shapiro, Class of 1972, Graduate Student Fellow Harvard University
bio: Sam Klug is a PhD candidate in history at Harvard University. His research interests include African American history, 20th-century American political and social thought, and the global history of colonialism and decolonization.
